instruction: Candid documentary photograph of a couple on a rocky shoreline under an overcast sky. The woman in the striped sweater (R2) stands in profile, laughing and looking to the left. The bearded man in the blue vest (R1) stands behind her, wearing glasses and smiling warmly as he hugs her from behind, wrapping his arms around her waist. The cool, natural daylight illuminates the scene, with the blue sea and grey sky creating a serene, windy atmosphere. The camera captures them in a medium shot, emphasizing their joyful interaction.
